ATX heading style produces hash-prefixed headings

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<h1>Title</h1><h2>Subtitle</h2>', HtmlToMarkdownRs::ConversionOptions.new(heading_style: 'Atx'))
puts result.inspect
```
